For executing python code use .venv virtual environment.
Activate it with `.venv\Scripts\activate` on Windows if not already activated.
Maintain list of dependencies in `requirements.txt`.
Install dependencies with `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
Always that you research store corresponding research md in .copilot-tracking
Always that you research look for previous research md to be relevant to the current research.
Always that you plan store corresponding plan md in .copilot-tracking
Always that you plan look for previous research and plan md relevant to the current plan.
Always that you review store corresponding review findings md in .copilot-tracking
Always that you plan look for previous review found issues and plan fixing them in corresponding plan md in .copilot-tracking.
Any intermediate image you create for the purpose of researching sprites, that is not needed in runtime, create it in the folder samples/analysis
